title: Fix Window Bottom Silhouette Around Nested Panes
description: UI bug: windows wrongly flow around panes on the bottom. Projection pane sits on top of the window like top panes (window options), and the window bottom must stay a normal rectangular bottom — nested Pane WindowChrome chips (e.g. projection at bottom-right) must not be measured into the enclosing mode-dock / window silhouette. Fix measureWindowSilhouetteMetrics to only count chips/gaps/caps owned by the measured [data-window-silhouette] stack, not nested silhouettes. Extend existing tests; verify.
summary:
Mode-dock window silhouettes were measuring nested Pane WindowChrome chips (e.g. projection at bottom-right with data-dock=bottom), so the enclosing window outline wrongly notched around bottom panes instead of staying rectangular while those panes overlay like window options.

Added windowSilhouetteOwnsElement so measureWindowSilhouetteMetrics only counts chips/gaps/caps whose nearest [data-window-silhouette] ancestor is the measured stack. Extended the existing Panel/silhouette vitest with a nested-pane regression. Verified: measureWindowSilhouetteMetrics + related silhouette/Mode dock/PaneHost cases 15/15.
